name: The Havoc Channel
source:
It's 1997 and the city of Brookside is devastated by an unexplainable phenomenon. Play as Seth Bentrew, a wet-behind-the-ears newscaster, to solve mysteries, learn about the city's past, and protect the Brookside citizens from disaster - all while sitting in the anchor man's chair.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4531580/The_Havoc_Channel/]Steam[/url]]
